_why: References that resolve on a branch this tree has deliberately NOT merged.

is not there.  These are a different thing -- the entry exists, it is
just on a branch being held back on purpose, so blocking the gate on
them would mean master cannot go green until somebody merges a branch
they have chosen not to merge.

from tools/gccdiverge.json.  refcheck fails if an entry here starts
RESOLVING -- because that means the branch landed and the entry is now a
lie -- exactly as it fails for a reference that dangles and is not
listed.  So this cannot rot into a permanent exemption: the day
v34-instrumentation merges, the gate demands these lines be deleted.

a branch that really contains the target and a reason a reader can
